(2) The vocal delivery remains fast-paced and persuasive, emphasizing key nouns with slight pitch rises. (3) BGM continues without interruption, maintaining a bright spectral profile and moderate volume that sits clearly beneath the vocals. (4) Short silent gaps between phrases are filled by the rhythmic synth bass of the music. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides three zero-cost skincare habits to improve skin health: washing makeup brushes weekly, cleaning smartphones daily, and brushing teeth before washing the face to prevent acne from toothpaste residue. It aims to position the presenter as a professional dermatology expert while promoting her clinic.
